The paper's separate classification of the recovered FBCC-A233 genome remains unchanged. No stock identity, assembly assignment, abundance, culture condition or biological assertion is newly certified.

limitations: Partial technical review with scientific_review:false. Passing scoped commands does not establish complete scientific review, current source-snippet validation, generated-product integration, aggregate QC or campaign completion.

The generic NCBI species-name route for Dolichospermum flos-aquae yields three ordered alternatives without a single classification block or inferred reference denominator. Those alternatives do not identify three candidate genomes for the experimental stock and do not replace or dispute the paper's separate GTDB-Tk v2.5.2/r226 placement of the recovered FBCC-A233 genome in the flosaquae cluster.

Sphingorhabdus_B has 27/27 filtered reference genomes and Brevundimonas has 221/221. These are generic genus populations, not study-stock assignments, culture abundance, recovered study-genome counts or a complete culture census. The paper's ANI/alignment-fraction comparisons and unnamed genome clusters remain separate evidence.

The native source proof retains the warning that Sphingorhabdus_B is not the type-anchored clade and that the type-bearing Sphingorhabdus lineage drew no genomes in this filtered population. The writer stores the reclassification flag but does not serialize that warning into the canonical block or native log. No new formal NCBI genus name or named species assignment is claimed.

Source reading covered the whole current record, prior scientific review and historical caller/ledger, plus selected retained primary Methods, genome-identification results, Table 2 and Discussion passages. This diagnostic did not newly inspect complete supplements, original figure pixels, assemblies, raw sequence data or experimental fluxes.

The FBCC-A233 designation, absent associate-stock fields, source names and quotations, stability and abundance annotations, cultivation settings, two COMMUNITY_LEVEL computational cofactor nodes, PARTIAL evidence and absence of causal arrows remain unchanged. Predicted cofactor pathways do not prove biotin or cobamide exchange, canonical cobalamin identity, uptake or growth dependence.

The immutable prior full scientific review remains needs_curation. Issues 1406, 2691, 2692 and 2693 remain unresolved by this generic correction; source-genome provenance is not completed by a generic genus mapping, and source-case, maintenance and abundance concerns are not waived.

Its upstream release and chronology are unestablished; file mtime is not a release identifier and is not the paper's r226 designation.
